WITH a AS
    (SELECT geometry
     FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
     WHERE id = 'f72bedb4-2cb5-499c-b24e-afd7b31053be')
SELECT b.id,
       b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.subtype,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS b,
     a
WHERE b.id != 'f72bedb4-2cb5-499c-b24e-afd7b31053be'
    AND b.subtype = 'county'
    AND ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry)
